correctness.rationale: Proposition 2.1 establishes an exact sampler up to relabeling. The actual standalone verifier exhaustively enumerates every attachment state for n=2..8, checks all degree-class covariances as exact rationals, and passes 2614 assertions.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The source propositions yield K as a sum of Bernoulli roots and the degree of one vertex as a Bernoulli–binomial sum. Neither marginal proposition determines their joint law or the sign for each finite-size degree count. The new conditional-exclusion calculation and factorization establish a joint identity not implied by merely combining marginal formulas. An older identity for the full attachment-dependent generating function could nevertheless yield it and remains a residual priority risk.

value.rationale: The claim determines the complete sign of each component-count/degree-frequency covariance in a natural stationary genetic forest, detects a finite n=3 equality, and gives an unexpected opposite sign when undirected degree-one is replaced by zero outdegree. Its exact linear-order asymptotic constants quantify the distinction. These structural correlations are not obtainable from the previously published marginal laws alone.
